summary: Channel-indexed float setter. Dispatches on index a2 via jump table jpt_5471DA (0x00547224); for a2 in 1..4 it stores the integer a3 scaled by the float constant 0.0039215689 (~1/255) into one of four float fields selected by channel (this+0x60, this+0x50, this+0x70, this+0x80 for channels 1..4). The default case writes nothing. Every path returns result = a2 - 1. Called by ConstructorInputControlInit (0x00546250).

local_names.this: object owning the four destination float fields
local_names.a2: channel index 1..4 selecting the destination float field; outside 1..4 the function returns without writing
local_names.a3: integer source value scaled by the float constant into the 0..1 range

operations.description: Compute result = a2 - 1, the value returned from every path
